chose: Card pictures render on one long-lived worker thread, one card at a time, from a leaf module (slack/cardPicture.ts) that imports only satori, Resvg and the fonts; the main thread writes the card's words and passes them along
over: rendering on the main thread, a worker per render, or a worker that loads cardDrawing.ts and its helpers
because: Resvg renders synchronously and satori's layout is CPU work, so on the main thread a render holds Slack's acks; a worker per render pays its start each time; loading playerCard.ts in the worker pulls most of the service (about 200 MiB RSS measured) into a second heap, the leaf brings the thread to about 150 MiB, flat over 300 renders

chose: The renderer thread's heap is capped at 64 MiB old and 8 MiB young generation
because: the worker's used heap stays near 33 MiB across 300 renders, but V8 reserved about 160 MiB by default; the young cap cut the thread's RSS by about 35 MiB with no slower render, and the old cap ends only a runaway card's thread, which the next card replaces
